description: Run pre-built Espresso (Android) or XCUITest (iOS) suites on BrowserStack by upload. Not for Appium: use setupBrowserStackAppAutomateTests.

accessibility.description: App Accessibility checks on touched screens (Android 11+, iOS 14+); suite needs BrowserStack's SDK.

appPath.description: Built .apk/.ipa inside MCP_UPLOAD_BASE_DIR (gradle assembleDebug, or xcodebuild archive and export).

devices.description: Only devices the user asked for, e.g. [['android', 'Samsung Galaxy S24', '14']].

deviceName.description: Device name, e.g. 'Samsung Galaxy S24', 'Google Pixel 8', 'iPhone 15', 'iPhone 14 Pro'

screenReader.description: Also run Screen Reader Automation; turns accessibility on.

screenReaderLinearNavigation.description: Screen reader swipes every screen in order.

testSuitePath.description: Built suite inside MCP_UPLOAD_BASE_DIR (gradle assembleAndroidTest, or zipped .xctestrun + Runner.app).

name: runAppTestsOnBrowserStack
